subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 1st day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: 1st day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four stern kuo-toa slowly circle the statue, alert and on guard, while a few others move about, gazing up at the statue and bowing repeatedly while chanting.
source_quote: Four stern kuo-toa slowly circle the statue, alert and on guard, while a few others move about

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately 500 feet away via the Darklake.
source_quote: almost 500 feet away, is another wall of nets

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 500 kuo-toans above the cavern floor.
source_quote: the village's western side of about 500 kuo-toans

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Sea Mother altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: shells, brightly colored stones, mushrooms, and rotting fish are piled at the statue’s feet and strung in garlands around its neck

subject: Darklake position
fact: The Darklake lies between the two nEttin g walls to the north.
source_quote: To the north, between the two nEttin g walls, is the Darklake

subject: cave wall position
fact: The cave wall lies between the two walls to the south.
source_quote: Between the two walls to the south is the cave wall

subject: village position
fact: The village lies between the walls of nEttin g, the cave wall, and the Darklake.
source_quote: Between the walls of nEttin g, the cave wall, and the Darklake is the village

subject: statue dimensions
fact: The statue of the Deep Sea Mother is roughly nine feet tall, carved from wood in the shape of a humanoid female.
source_quote: the sizeable nine-foot-tall statue. The statue is roughly carved from wood in the shape of a humanoid female

subject: statue materials
fact: The statue's head and forearms are formed from the severed head and claws of a giant albino crayfish, lashed on with strands of gut.
source_quote: its head and forearms formed from the severed head and claws of a giant albino crayfish. These parts are lashed on with strands of gut

subject: statue offerings
fact: Shells, brightly colored stones, mushrooms, and rotting fish are piled at the statue’s feet and strung in garlands around its neck.
source_quote: Shells, brightly colored stones, mushrooms, and rotting fish are piled at the statue’s feet and strung in garlands around its neck

subject: statue stench
fact: The statue emits an overpowering stench of rotting shellfish.
source_quote: emit an overpowering stench of rotting shellfish

subject: docks position
fact: The docks lie on the Darklake side.
source_quote: The Darklake side has docks

subject: docks condition
fact: Some of the docks have boats; some are empty.
source_quote: Some of the docks have boats. Some are empty

subject: huts position
fact: The huts of the kuo-toans lie past the walls.
source_quote: Past the walls are the huts of the kuo-toans

subject: house materials
fact: Each home has mud walls, and the ceilings are made from an unidentified dried vegetable matter.
source_quote: Each home has mud walls, and the ceilings are made from an unidentified dried vegetable matter

subject: statue of Leemooggoogoon position
fact: The idol of Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father is located near the southern cave wall.
source_quote: They sneak out just close enough to see the idol of Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father

subject: idol dimensions
fact: The idol of Leemooggoogoon consists of a large hide cut roughly in the shape of a manta ray and stretched out on cords between two support poles.
source_quote: It consists of a large hide cut roughly in the shape of a manta ray and stretched out on cords between two support poles

subject: idol offerings
fact: A dead, splayed-out manta ray is pinned to the center of the hide. Two dead octopuses are draped across the top, their tentacles pinned and artfully arrayed, their heads tied together and painted with red and blue pigments.
source_quote: A dead, splayed-out manta ray is pinned to the center of the hide. Two dead octopuses are draped across the top, their tentacles pinned and artfully arrayed, their heads tied together and painted with red and blue pigments

subject: idol stench
fact: The idol reeks of decay.
source_quote: The idol reeks of decay

subject: altar condition
fact: The broad stone altar below the idol is stained dark with blood.
source_quote: the broad stone altar below the idol is stained dark with blood

subject: ritual requirement
fact: The sacrifice is essential, not the provenance.
source_quote: the sacrifice is essential, not the provenance

subject: sacrifice preference
fact: An unwilling sacrifice is better. This is an evil god.
source_quote: An unwilling sacrifice is better. This is an evil god

subject: ritual comparison
fact: Our rituals are different.
source_quote: Yes, our rituals are different

subject: statue of Deep Father position
fact: The idol of Leemooggoogoon is located near the southern cave wall.
source_quote: They sneak out just close enough to see the idol of Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father

subject: combat protocol
fact: You will help us as you, too, see the righteousness of the Deep Mother. But you won’t throw the first punch.
source_quote: You will help us as you, too, see the righteousness of the Deep Mother. No, that would insult the honor of my father and our people. This is our problem, and we must resolve it.

source_quote: twelve kuo-toa led by a kuo-toa monitor arrive at Ploopploopeen’s quarters
